verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency is a fair question for a SaaS scheduling product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no published per-seat price list and no breakdown of what each tier includes. The only pricing signals are a vague 'generous free tier' claim, a passing reference to 'organization/enterprise plans', and community comments about a $29/month premium username, none of which document per-seat tier costs.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-seat pricing tells me exactly what each tier costs and includes before I talk to sales
